doctrine: Existing research is a donor/source for the generalized Machine Epistemics theory and OCM. PARENT_SUFFICIENT kills narrow ownership claims but does not prevent adoption/generalization.

entries.mechanism: self-perturbation -> observed consequences -> predictive self-model -> structural action
entries.established_result: self-intervention can train predictive self-knowledge; model-guided action is not automatically better than direct empirical repair
entries.known_failure_boundary: reported CIFAR/ResNet robustness advantage not established; direct empirical policy can match model-guided action
entries.prior_information_charge: paper mechanism and any implementation supplied to OCM are external prior information
entries.theory_contribution: self-intervention is a general route for learning self-observability but not an OCM residual
entries.cross_domain_prediction: verified interventions across different cognitive components should improve future diagnosis only when observation channels are informative
entries.required_experiment: real OCM failure diagnosis with matched direct empirical/probabilistic parent

entries.mechanism: open-ended self-modification with archived stepping-stone variants
entries.established_result: non-monotonic branches/archives can preserve useful stepping stones
entries.known_failure_boundary: archive search itself can be expensive and is not unique to epistemic architectures
entries.theory_contribution: separate monotonic deployment safety from non-monotonic developmental search
entries.cross_domain_prediction: shadow branches are useful only when intermediate representations unlock descendants unavailable to local monotonic search
entries.required_experiment: OCM deceptive self-change worlds with broader-search/DGM-style parent

entries.mechanism: modular architecture search with comparative reflective memory and cross-branch lessons
entries.established_result: comparative branch experience can improve later search/credit assignment
entries.known_failure_boundary: does not by itself establish exact epistemic revision or generalized cognitive-development law
entries.theory_contribution: self-change experience should become reusable meta-experience, but this requires stronger parent subtraction
entries.cross_domain_prediction: lessons that are genuinely structural should transfer across reminted failure families
entries.required_experiment: disjoint OCM incidents with MARS-style matched reflective parent

entries.mechanism: explicit alternative/conjunctive support, dependency maintenance, local invalidation/revision
entries.established_result: explicit dependency/support systems can support exact incremental revision
entries.known_failure_boundary: dependency discovery and maintenance cost may dominate; incomplete support models create false locality
entries.prior_information_charge: support/revision algorithms are mature parent mechanisms
entries.theory_contribution: local revision is an ingredient, not a novelty claim; structure discovery becomes the harder question
entries.cross_domain_prediction: same support semantics should survive language/math/science/coding while domain authority differs
entries.required_experiment: learn higher-order support under redundant/conditional causes then revise exactly

entries.source: DreamCoder / Stitch / grammar and library learning
entries.mechanism: discover reusable abstractions/macros that compress traces and reduce future program search
entries.established_result: reusable learned abstractions can amortize later program synthesis/search
entries.known_failure_boundary: learned abstraction may be a primitive alias, overfit, or fail to amortize discovery/maintenance cost
entries.prior_information_charge: library-learning machinery and hypothesis language must be counted
entries.theory_contribution: method discovery is parent-rich; OCM residual requires warranted scope/revision/cross-domain lifecycle or a new joint law
entries.cross_domain_prediction: domain-neutral method structure should be frozen before target-domain transfer and causally reduce later search
entries.required_experiment: cross-episode method induction with DreamCoder/Stitch-class matched parent and restart ablation
